# Introductory Videos for C++

Get started with C++ in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} by watching these introductory videos! These videos are designed to help you set up C++ IntelliSense and build and debug C++ projects in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. After watching these quick tutorials, you'll be able to enjoy {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}'s rich C++ feature set.
